text: An investment of up to $300,000 is recommended. The proposed investment will not be advanced unless it meets risk/reward and Greenhouse Gas impact expectations and appropriate terms, including security and other conditions, are approved by the Investment Committee.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Adopted the confidential instructions in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (July 5, 2018) from the Vice President, Impact Investing. 2. Directed that the confidential information contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (July 5, 2018) from the Vice President, Impact Investing remain confidential in its entirety as it pertains to the security of property belonging to the City of Toronto; commercial and financial information, supplied in confidence to the City of Toronto, which, if disclosed, could reasonably be expected to prejudice significantly the competitive position or interfere significantly with the contractual or other negotiations of a person, group of persons, or organization; and a position to be applied to any negotiations carried on or to be carried on by or on behalf of the City of Toronto.
